evidence.name: Screen field: Seconds Or Minutes
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Seconds Or Minutes" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Seconds Or Minutes
sections.description: Sets whether the auto-advance duration above counts in seconds or minutes. Only shows when auto-advance is on. Seconds is the right choice for nearly every onboarding screen; minutes is rarely useful and risks visitors leaving before the screen ever advances.
